dataset.name: Amazon US FBA Fee Rates 2026
dataset.description: Complete Amazon US Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) fee schedule for 2026: referral fee rates by category, FBA fulfillment fees by size tier AND per-weight rungs within each tier (non-peak and peak columns, apparel card included), monthly storage rates, aged inventory surcharges, inbound placement fees, low-inventory-level fee, return processing fees, the fuel & logistics surcharge, the 2026-10-15 peak-fulfilment uplift table, and the 2026 return policy.

Individual source rows traced to the Seller Central rate cards listed in dataset.sources. last_verified is the date of the last human-attested independent row-by-row check; the daily automated watch does NOT advance it (see dataset.verification and the companion data/rate-snapshot.json watched_date / verification_kind).

referral_fees.category_zh: 3D 打印机（前 $200 收 12% / 超出部分 5%）
referral_fees.min_note: INHERITED, NOT SOURCED. The 2027 fee announcement does not state a minimum referral fee for 3D printers; $0.30 is the official minimum of the 20 categories re-sourced on 2026-09-24e. Exposure is theoretical (a $0.30 floor cannot bind above ~$3 of price) but this is an inference, not a fact.

fulfillment_fees_dangerous_goods_standar._note: Dangerous-goods fulfillment card for STANDARD size tiers. Same page as fulfillment_fees (Seller Central GABBX6GZPA8MSZGW) but a separate table captioned 'FBA Non-Peak Fulfillment Fees (for dangerous goods)'. MUST be read from the en-US locale: the zh-CN locale of that page omits both standard-size DG tables entirely (21 tables vs 19), which is why DG used to be modelled as bulky/oversized only. Figures EXCLUDE the 3.5% fuel & logistics surcharge.
fulfillment_fees_dangerous_goods_standar.weight_step_rule_3_to_20_lb: $0.08 per 4 oz interval above the first 3 lb, rounded up to the next 4 oz

rates.aged_inventory_surcharge_note: AIS is charged IN ADDITION to the monthly storage fee, not instead of it. Bands 181-270 exclude clothing, footwear, bags, jewelry and watches. On the 366-455 and 456+ bands Amazon charges the GREATER of the per-cu-ft rate and the per_unit_min_usd, so a per-cu-ft-only model understates long-stored small items.

inbound_placement_current.effective: current (unchanged from 2027-01-15; standard-size Central region merged into East, placement regions 3 -> 2)

options.single_location: ship to one location; fee applies
options.partial_split: big items only, 2-3 locations; lower fee than single
options.amazon_optimized_split: no fee; requires >=5 identical cartons or pallets per SKU (same item mix and quantities)

inbound_placement_current.excluded: oversize items are NOT charged an inbound placement fee
inbound_placement_current.charged: 45 days after receipt, based on received quantity
inbound_placement_current.billable_weight_rule: small standard uses item weight; large standard and above use the greater of item weight and dimensional weight

inbound_placement_current.new_seller_credit: USD 400 credit toward inbound placement fees for new sellers who create their first shipment within 90 days of launch
inbound_placement_current.note_on_replaced_values: The previous four flat options (Minimal placement / Partial placement / Small parcel / None) do NOT exist on the official page and are retired.

tiers.note: longest>59 or second>33 or shortest>33 or long+girth>130, or billable weight>50

size_tier_definitions_2026.extra_large_threshold: longest side >96in or long+girth >130in (and <=150 lb) = 特大号 item

billable_weight_rule.dim_weight_formula: L(in) x W(in) x H(in) / 139, result in lb
billable_weight_rule.price_band_boundaries: prices of exactly $10 or $50 are billed at the $10-$50 rate
billable_weight_rule.peak_determination: FBA fees are determined by the ship date, not the order date

rates.return_processing_fees_note: return_processing_fees (flat, 7 rows) is DEPRECATED: it was non-apparel only, used invented tier labels ('Small Standard (<6 oz)', 'Large Standard (6 oz-1 lb)') and carried $5.00 for all bulky tiers, a value that does not appear in the official table. Read return_processing_fees_full instead.

return_processing_fees_full.change_note: Only the size tiers change - the rate numbers are the same on both sides of the change. The old 7 flat rows were both too coarse AND missing the entire apparel column.

effective.note: apparel/shoes are charged on EVERY returned unit with no threshold; other categories only on returns above the category threshold

rules.min_units_exemption: a product with fewer than 25 units shipped in a month pays nothing
rules.new_selection_exemption: first 20 returned units per eligible parent ASIN, returns must reach the FC within 120 days of the first inbound date
rules.return_rate_definition: percent of units shipped in a month that are actually returned in that month and the following two calendar months
rules.charge_timing: charged between the 7th and 15th of the THIRD month after the shipped month
rules.threshold_review: reviewed quarterly, measured over a three-calendar-month window

low_inventory_level_fee.unit: USD per shipped unit, charged IN ADDITION to the FBA fulfillment fee
low_inventory_level_fee.trigger: charged only when BOTH the long-term (90-day) and short-term (30-day) historical days of supply are below 28; the tier uses the GREATER of the two
low_inventory_level_fee.metric: average daily inventory units on hand / average daily shipped units, per FNSKU, refreshed weekly
low_inventory_level_fee.note: A product with zero shipped units in the window has an undefined days-of-supply, which Amazon treats as above 28 -> not charged. Do not model it as days=0.

peak_fulfillment.unit: USD per shipped unit, charged IN ADDITION to the non-peak fulfilment fee
peak_fulfillment.avg_per_unit_note: Amazon's headline '~$0.32 per unit' is a network-wide blended average. It is NOT the uplift for any single SKU - read uplift_usd_by_tier.
peak_fulfillment.composition_order: (non-peak base + extra-weight overage + peak uplift) x (1 + fuel_surcharge). NOT (fee x 1.035) + uplift.
peak_fulfillment.amazon_shipping_schedule_note: Amazon Shipping (FBM) runs a separately dated schedule (2026-10-25 to 2027-01-16, shoulder 0.5 / peak 0.75). Do not reuse the FBA numbers for it.
peak_fulfillment.source: Amazon US FBA 2026 holiday peak fulfilment fee rate card

return_policy.note: The FBA fulfilment fee is NOT refunded when a unit comes back, so a return wastes the fulfilment already paid on that unit. The referral fee IS credited back, minus a refund administration fee of 20% capped at $5.00. If fulfilment is already modelled as a per-unit fee on every shipped unit, the incremental return cost is the admin fee plus (where the category threshold is met) the returns processing fee - do NOT add the fulfilment fee a second time. Returns processing fees apply to units ABOVE the category threshold; apparel and footwear are 0%, so every returned unit pays there. Categories under 25 shipped units in a month are exempt.

storage_peak.note: Storage peaks Oct 1 and reverts Jan 1; fulfilment peaks Oct 15 and reverts Jan 15. The two windows overlap for only ~2.5 months, not a clean quarter - model them separately or a Q4 estimate will not reconcile to the Fee Preview report.
